import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set color palette
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Pairwise scatter plot - Petal Length vs Petal Width (top left)
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 0].scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                       label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width (top right)
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 1].scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                       label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plot of petal length by species (bottom left)
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
df_petal = df_melted[df_melted['measurement'].isin(['petal_length', 'petal_width'])]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', ax=axes[1, 0], 
            palette=colors, width=0.6)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# 4. Violin plot of sepal length by species (bottom right)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='sepal_length', ax=axes[1, 1], 
               palette=colors, inner='quartile')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sepal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# Add main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Flower Species Analysis - Comprehensive Overview', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
